tokens.name: brand-slate
tokens.usage: Deep Slate. The trust anchor: logo rule, light-mode text, dark-mode cards. Brand constant, same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-night
tokens.usage: Night. Dark-mode canvas and the text color on copper. Brand constant.

tokens.name: brand-copper
tokens.usage: Burnt Copper. The Ready line in the logo and the only action color. Never as small text on a light background (3.0:1).

tokens.name: brand-alabaster
tokens.usage: Alabaster. Light-mode canvas. Brand constant.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Sky. The on-track signal as a dot or fill only; too light for text on light backgrounds (2.7:1).

tokens.name: brand-amber
tokens.usage: Muted Amber. The behind signal hue. Kept darker than copper so a warning never looks like a button.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background (the 60%).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, question cards, inputs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text and headings on canvas or surface (light 14.0:1, dark 16.3:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, metadata (light 7.2:1, dark 5.7:1 on surface).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px structural borders on cards and dividers. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and outlined buttons; meets 3:1 against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, focus ring, selected answer edge, the Ready indicator.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover: lighter, so its night text gains contrast (6.8:1).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action fills (5.6:1). Never white on copper (3.2:1).

tokens.name: ontrack-dot
tokens.usage: On-track dot, bar fill and correct-answer edge.

tokens.name: ontrack-ink
tokens.usage: On-track label text (light 5.2:1 on its tint, dark 5.7:1).

tokens.name: ontrack-tint
tokens.usage: On-track badge and correct-answer background.

tokens.name: behind-dot
tokens.usage: Behind dot, bar fill and wrong-answer edge.

tokens.name: behind-ink
tokens.usage: Behind label text (light 6.4:1 on its tint, dark 10.4:1).

tokens.name: behind-tint
tokens.usage: Behind badge and wrong-answer background.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Not started, locked and inactive states: a quiet gray, no signal (muted text on it: light 6.7:1, dark 4.8:1).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: App screen titles on phones, card headlines.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: Exam question stems: larger, airy, max 65ch.
styles.sample: Which provision lets a policyowner keep coverage after missing a premium?

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text and answer options, max 70ch.
styles.sample: Each session mixes new material with reviews timed to just before you'd forget.

spacing.note: 8pt grid. 4px is the only half step (icon gaps, 12px button padding = 4 + 8).

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon to label, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight groups, between options.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, form gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, button side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page blocks in the app.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Landing sub-sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between landing sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between landing sections on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, answer options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, mockup containers.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. The only shadow is the focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control (3.0:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).
